sentences.en: Ah no. It's not as though I always have everything.
sentences.zh: 啊，不是这样的。我并不是总是一切都准备好了。

sentences.en: Ah, I reckon you go straight down this prefectural road ...
sentences.zh: 啊，我想你应该沿着这条县道直走……

sentences.en: Car? Ah, if you mean that limousine, - I chartered it.
sentences.zh: 汽车？哦，如果你说的是那辆豪华轿车的话——是我租的。
